assessment.nobel_worthiness: A highly distinctive visionary voice. Blinding, the first volume of the Orbitor trilogy, and the later Solenoid build dense, patterned prose in which memory, the body, dream and cosmology form a single metaphysical project. The oeuvre also includes poetry and shorter fiction, which suggests range and a sustained formal ambition. Its imaginative depth and its place within the European novel tradition are persuasive under common criteria.
assessment.attribution: The citation would rest on the large-scale visionary novel, and on the way memory and the body become metaphysical architecture, across a body of work written in Romanian. The credit is clearly to a single author whose work forms a coherent project.
assessment.maturity: Decades of work with a consistent, evolving project, and the major novels are long established. There is no apparent timing obstacle to a recommendation now.
uncertainties: My judgment of the prose texture depends on translations and on public knowledge. I have not independently verified sources, and the density of the Romanian is only partly conveyed in translation.
Corpus coverage: the early poetry and some shorter work may be less available in translation than the major novels.
Whether the later novels sustain the originality of the earlier ones is a judgment that remains open.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A major renewal of modern Arabic poetic language over many decades. Works such as Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses use myth, fragmentation and a critical dialogue with the classical Arabic heritage. His essays on poetics and tradition add intellectual depth. His formal and linguistic achievement is exceptional, and his significance for the language is wide.
assessment.attribution: The citation would rest on the transformation of Arabic poetry and poetics through both verse and critical prose. Credit is clearly to him as a single writer, and the work is in Arabic.
assessment.maturity: A very long and fully developed oeuvre with a secure historical position. The main question is timing and committee weighing rather than the depth of the body of work.
uncertainties: Much of the achievement lies in Arabic sound, metre and the dialogue with inherited forms, which translation conveys only partially.
My knowledge of the full corpus in translation is limited, and I cannot independently verify it.
How his essays and poetry weigh relative to each other in a citation is a matter of judgment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carpentaria and The Swan Book are large, polyphonic novels that remake narrative form through Indigenous sovereignty, oral storytelling practices and ecological time. The voice is distinctive and the formal ambition is high. Her nonfiction extends the project into collective memory and politics. Her imaginative depth and her influence on the novel in English are strong.
assessment.attribution: The citation would rest on the reinvention of the novel from within Indigenous Australian storytelling and ecological thinking, in English. Credit is to a single author, though collective and communal forms are central to her method.
assessment.maturity: A major body of work, but the fiction oeuvre is smaller than that of several others on the list. Whether it is yet at full breadth is a fair question, though the quality of the major novels is high.
uncertainties: The number of major novels is limited, so sustained quality over a long career is harder to judge.
The political and cultural significance of the work should not substitute for literary assessment, and I weigh the formal achievement separately.
My account depends on public knowledge and not on independent verification of sources.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large poetic sequences such as Purgatory and Anteparadise turn violence and suffering into collective memorial forms. He also extends poetry beyond the page into landscape-scale interventions. The voice is unmistakable, and the project has moral and imaginative weight. The formal range is considerable and the oeuvre has sustained force.
assessment.attribution: The citation would rest on poetry as collective memory and witness after dictatorship, in Spanish. It is a single-author oeuvre, though some landscape works go beyond the printed text.
assessment.maturity: A decades-long body of work with a secure place in Latin American poetry. The work is mature and consistent.
uncertainties: Poetry in translation loses much of the rhythm and language-specific effects.
It is uncertain how the landscape-scale and visual interventions should be weighed as literature against the written books.
The historical context is powerful, but the committee should judge the language and form, not the subject alone.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Writing in both Japanese and German, she turns linguistic estrangement into narrative and poetic invention. The Emissary and Memoirs of a Polar Bear show a playful, philosophical imagination and a distinctive voice. The formal and linguistic achievement is original, and the range across fiction, poetry, essays and drama is wide.
assessment.attribution: The citation would rest on bilingual literary practice and the use of language itself as a creative engine across genres. Credit is to a single author who writes in two languages, which makes corpus coverage particularly important.
assessment.maturity: A substantial oeuvre developed over several decades, with growing international recognition. The work is mature, although parts of the German-language and poetic output are less known to me.
uncertainties: Her work spans two languages, and the translations of the Japanese and German texts may differ in how much of the wordplay survives.
I am less sure of the sustained depth of the whole corpus than of the best-known novels.
Some works rely on wordplay that is difficult to evaluate in translation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Housekeeping and Gilead show a meditative, morally serious prose with a clear and distinctive voice. Theology, family and American history are brought into patient dialogue, and the essays extend the intellectual project. The depth of interiority and the control of language are high.
assessment.attribution: The citation would rest on contemplative, theologically informed fiction and essays in English. Credit is to a single author with a coherent project.
assessment.maturity: A consistent body of work over decades, though the novels are relatively few and the essays are a significant part of the oeuvre. The late novels continue the Gilead world, which raises questions of breadth against depth.
uncertainties: The oeuvre is narrow in scope, and the committee would need to decide whether the depth compensates.
The Christian and American focus may limit perceived breadth, but that is a question of weight, not of quality.
My assessment is based on public knowledge, and I have not independently verified the sources.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dreamlike, destabilizing narratives such as Frontier and Love in the New Millennium disrupt ordinary psychology, space and causality. The voice is very distinctive and radically experimental, with a clear formal project sustained over a long career.
assessment.attribution: The citation would rest on a singular experimental fiction in Chinese that departs from realist expectations. Credit is to a single author, and the project is highly individual.
assessment.maturity: A long and productive career with a consistent, uncompromising approach. Whether the work develops or mainly repeats its method is a judgment I cannot settle from my knowledge.
uncertainties: Reliance on a limited set of translations means that I may not be seeing the full range or the changes across the corpus.
The prose in Chinese may differ in texture from the English versions, and I cannot verify this.
The density of the experimental method may make the work harder to cite succinctly.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A desert cosmology joins Tuareg experience, ecological limits and metaphysical fiction, in works such as Gold Dust and The Bleeding of the Stone. The imaginative world is distinctive and mythic, and the work is sustained across a large number of novels.
assessment.attribution: The citation would rest on a fictional world drawn from Tuareg culture and the desert, written in Arabic. Credit is to a single author, and the project is coherent.
assessment.maturity: A large oeuvre developed over decades. How well the later novels sustain the early distinctiveness is uncertain from my knowledge.
uncertainties: Only part of the large oeuvre is available in translation, so coverage of the whole is incomplete.
The quality of the Arabic prose is difficult to assess in translation.
It is uncertain whether the fiction is sufficiently varied across its many volumes.
